title: Get Involved
description: Attend a workshop, volunteer, or collaborate with Bay Area Youth Conservation.

header.heading: Three ways to join in.
header.body: You do not need experience or a long-term commitment. Pick whichever fits, and reach out.

cards.heading: Attend a workshop
cards.body: Join the every-two-month workshop series at San Leandro Library for climate learning, hands-on projects, and conversation.

cards.heading: Volunteer with us
cards.body: Take part in local opportunities that help students contribute time, energy, and care to the places around them.

cards.heading: Collaborate
cards.body: We work with schools, clubs, libraries, and local groups to bring youth conservation projects and education to more people.

collaboration.heading: Bring youth conservation education to your community space.
collaboration.body: Bay Area Youth Conservation is open to students and youth leaders who want to build local chapters around workshops, volunteer projects, and conservation education.
